definitions.full: H3859. laham [ לָהַם ] verb swallow greedily (= Arabic ; Di Lex, Ethiopic 25 compare Ethiopic ox, cow ); — only Hithpa`el Participle מִתְלַהֲמִים Prov 18:8 i.e. bits greedily swallowed, dainties , = 26:22 , simile of tale-bearer's words.
